class.name: HEGoGraphPathMesh
class.brief_description: Builds the path visualisation of a [HEGoGraph3D]: a translucent ribbon or tube along every connection, with an outline, in the graph's local space.
class.description: Ribbon rows are oriented to the surface normal (from a [HEGoGraphSurface], else up). Where connections meet, every arm is cut back far enough that neighbouring edges meet, and the gap is filled by a fan around the node, so overlapping connections never double the transparency and sharp turns stay clean. A tube is a cylinder per connection plus a sphere at each node.

method.name: build
method.description: Builds the mesh for [param graph]. [param surface] may be null.
